hunt.what: After Save on the kitchen plan, the party page's Party bill and the "Take balance" button keep the old amounts until the page is reloaded.
hunt.steps: Manager: Edit party, Calamari 2->3, add French fries, remove the fruit plate, water 2->3, Save. The kitchen card shows the new plan, but Party bill still read Add-ons ฿815, Total ฿17715, Outstanding ฿16715 and the button "Take balance ฿16715" about a minute later. After a reload: ฿1170, ฿18070, ฿17070, "Take balance ฿17070" (the settle preview and the BEO both said ฿18,070 / ฿17,070).
hunt.where: apps/pos/src/lib/partySettlementBill.ts usePlannedSettleQuote: its key (party id, settlement id/state, partySettleFormDefaults) does not change when only the kitchen plan's lines change, so the planned quote is not asked again after a kitchen save.

hunt.what: A note the manager types on a food line ("no sauce") is not shown on the party page's Kitchen plan card; it is in the Edit form, the BEO and the kitchen slip.
hunt.where: apps/pos/src/lib/partyKitchen.ts partyMenuLineLabel (no note; the bar label partyBarLineLabel has one), used in PartyDetail.tsx planSection

hunt.what: In the Edit form a line's read-only name box cuts its marks: "ZZ TEST mango sticky rice · not on the till menu" shown in 304 of 340 px; party 2's "ZZ TEST nuggets · kids only · not on the til…" and "ZZ TEST steak · adults · not on the till men…". On a real dish the "adults" / "not on the till menu" marks can be what is cut.
hunt.where: apps/pos/src/components/parties/PartyKitchenPlanEditor.tsx LineRows, the read-only Input (value lineLabel) beside the stepper and the remove button

hunt.what: The refusal names an internal line id: "Kitchen plan not saved — The OTO App did not change the kitchen plan: A line of the kitchen plan was changed in the BEO since the till read it (zz907-calamari). Read the party again and make the change once more. Press Cancel, then Edit party: it opens on the plan read again." On a real BEO the id is a code like menu_17…; the dish name is not said, and two instructions are given.

A party whose BEO has no kitchen plan yet opens the prototype's editable Kitchen and Bar sections for everyone (reception too): switch, Add item, cake fields. Typing a dish and pressing Save gives "Not saved here — kitchen plan and bar plan are kept in the OTO App — change them there." and nothing is written. A manager cannot start a kitchen plan from the till.
hunt.where: apps/pos/src/components/parties/PartyEditForm.tsx (the prototype sections when the plan read is null)

hunt.what: A slip made by the till's edit says "Plan changed in the OTO App" (the change was made on the till); a dish added on the till that is already in the set menu prints as a second "1× French fries" line, not 2×.
Settle party groups its figures ("฿18,010"); the payment step after Confirm says "Amount Due ฿18010" and "Balance due ฿18010.00" ungrouped; the party page bill is ungrouped too ("฿19010").
A double press of Save changes (party 2, a typed line added) sent one write; the BEO has the line once; one audit row per Save.
The till locked on inactivity (about two minutes) while the Settle party form was open; after unlocking, the form was gone with nothing confirmed. Settle again worked.
